text:
annika_csm: quick sync — Stratosync dedicated bring-up Monday 07:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale rules, soak plan, and customer enablement checklist. Can we lock today? :calendar: 

tyler_infra: proposing reserved 10x A40, burst cap to 14. Customer asked to be conservative on commit; we can autoscale above 10 when queue/backpressure shows.

mira_sre: autoscale rules I'd use:
- scale-out +1 when avg GPU util > 66% for 180s
- aggressive burst: add up to 4 instances if queue latency > 800ms for 60s
- scale-in when util < 30% for 8m
- eviction cooldown: 3m

carlos_ml: load mix: chat-heavy (65% ~1.5k tokens), embeddings 20%, short-gen 15%. I'll push seed set and a small prompt slice for QoE checks. Also request we monitor generated token variance and model sampling flags.

annika_csm: please paste seeds and the exact load command. Also need a one-pager for the customer's SREs covering rollback and fallback.

carlos_ml: seeds at s3://stratosync/onboard/seeds-v3.txt

carlos_ml: loadgen example:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/stratosync --qps 250 --duration 2700 \
  --profile chat-heavy --seeds s3://stratosync/onboard/seeds-v3.txt --concurrency 60 --timeout 12s
```

tyler_infra: prewarm plan: compile kernels and populate KV + LRU priming 30m prior. prewarm cmd:
```
./scripts/prewarm_pool --name stratosync --minutes 30 --priming-threads 8
```

run-bot: Provision job scheduled: 1765443600  stratosync-dedicated-provision

mira_sre: add canary: 1 instance handling 3% traffic for 6m, then 15m ramp to 25% before full. Fallback: route to hosted family if p95 > 2.2s for 2 consecutive mins. Also set token-bucket shaping: 350ms burst window to avoid short spikes.

sam_account: confirmed with customer: they'll accept 10 reserved with autoscale to 14 if week1 cost delta < 22%. I'll send the estimate after infra posts expected burn.

tyler_infra: posting expected instance-hours and hourly burn to this thread shortly. Will tag dashboards with customer:stratosync env:dedicated and stream to #ops-dashboard.

carlos_ml: if we see >3% 429s, recommend immediate qps throttle -20% and re-evaluate cache hit ratio. Also capture sample outputs for evals.

annika_csm: enablement call at 06:45 PT day-of to walk runbook & fallback. I'll send invite to their oncall. Post-run feedback link: https://forms.redwood/bringup-feedback (takes 3 min).

mira_sre: check-in 06:20 PT for final go/no-go.

annika_csm: thanks team  we'll run the checklist and capture notes in confluence after. :white_check_mark:
